I gathered from it that my father has spent much on us and much of it is from Sood. So do not pressurize him for more expenditures so that he is forced to stick to Sood. I also get disheartened because he has started taking out money from Soodi investments upon our insistence but he does not really consider it a sin. He says it is not that kind of forbidden Sood. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 36957 Country: India Title: I am a student and I am not able to purchase an authorized original software like Autocad etc which is too costly i.e. Rs 30000/-. Question: I am a student and I am not able to purchase an authorized original software like Autocad etc which is too costly i.e. Rs 30000/-. Can I use pirated software for only learning purpose? These software are available free of cost for American students as I know. Answer ID: 36957 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 424/424/M=1433) Though the mere use of pirated software shall not be termed as haram and unlawful but it is against caution. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
